title: ASUS PB278Q 27" WQHD Professional Monitor
subtitle: 27" 2560 x 1440 | 178° viewing | HDMI, DisplayPort, DVI, D-Sub
description: 27-inch WQHD office and design monitor with wide viewing angles, full sRGB coverage, built-in speakers and a stand that tilts, pivots and adjusts in height. Specifications verified against ASUS's official product page (Spanish-language regional site).
highlights: HDMI 1.4, DisplayPort 1.2, dual-link DVI and D-Sub
review_notes: Source page is ASUS's Spanish-language regional overview; evidence quoted verbatim in Spanish, values translated.

images.description: An ASUS PB278Q computer monitor displaying the Wikipedia multi-language homepage. The monitor is running at its native 2560x1440 resolution. Firefox is showing wikipedia.org at 200% zoom in fullscreen mode running on Arch Linux. Also visible in the photo below the monitor is a Fosi Audio K5 Pro stereo DAC, a Kinivo 501BN HDMI switch, the 4-button wired remote controller for a Kceve-brand 4x4 USB 3.0 switcher, and a Lepy LP-2020A stereo amplifier. Micca-brand bookshelf speakers are partially visible on either side of the monitor, and a Keychron K8 keyboard and Anker USB hub are just barely visible in the edges of the frame. All of this is on top of a LTT Northern Lights Desk Pad.
